thesis.text: GG1 is a dual-commodity NE Queensland explorer using a discounted, director-backed rights issue to fund near-term drilling at high-grade Herberton copper-silver-tin targets (Copper Hills, Siberia-Mt Gossan, Elizabeth Bluffs) and Chillagoe gold resource growth (Mt Wandoo, Sentinel), with multiple assay catalysts expected through late 2026; success could re-rate the stock materially given the small $3.2m raise size relative to reported high-grade intercepts, but permanent capital loss risk remains high given early-stage, pre-resource status of most targets.
